name: UXUS Agent Services
description: Pay-per-call primitives for AI agents on Base. Inference, scraping, extraction, embeddings, search, and wallet risk scoring. No accounts, no API keys — just a USDC wallet.

resources.description: Returns the completion text, the model that produced it (from a 5-model fallback chain), token usage, and latency_ms.
Returns the fetched page past bot-blocking: title, meta description, body as markdown/text/html, a character count, and a truncation flag.
Returns a JSON object populated to the schema you post, extracted from your text or URL, plus the model that produced it.
Returns one 1024-dim jina-embeddings-v3 vector per input string (up to 64), with the dimension count and token usage.
Returns a ranked list of {title, url, description} results plus which provider (Serper, Brave, or DuckDuckGo) served them.

Adds to the free /api/risk (score, level, verdict, flags): per-signal reasons with severity, the raw signals object (token tax/mint/proxy/hidden-owner flags, or wallet age + tx counts), and the sources behind every flag.
Returns risk_score (0-100), risk_level, a PROCEED/CAUTION/BLOCK verdict, and flags for any EVM wallet or token. No reasons, signals, or sources — /api/risk/pro adds those.
Returns every service with its id, method, URL, price, and parameter list in one JSON call — the machine-readable storefront index.
MCP server over JSON-RPC 2.0. Returns tool results inline for free tools; for paid tools returns the x402 endpoint, price, and pay-to address. GET returns server metadata.
Returns the mutable-risk verdict, mutable_risk_score (0-100), can_turn_hostile, and time_to_rug for a token. /api/risk/live/pro adds the per-power breakdown and raw controls.

Adds to the free /api/risk/live (verdict, mutable_risk_score, time_to_rug): every owner power explained in plain English, the raw controls object (owner, EIP-1967 implementation + admin slots, pause state, pending owner), and the on-chain reads to reproduce the score.

The same full report as /api/risk/pro (reasons, signals, sources), settled through the x402 Bazaar / CDP resource-server flow. Returns the free score/verdict/flags summary when no payment is presented.
Returns the newest DEX pools on Base/Ethereum (pair, token address, liquidity, FDV, 24h volume, age, flags), each with a riskCheck link into /api/risk/live.

Returns one normalized envelope — address, chain, chain_detected, exists, risk_score, risk_level, verdict, flags, entity, upgrade — for any EVM 0x or XRPL classic r-address, chain auto-detected from the format.

query.address: required — EVM 0x address or XRPL classic r-address

resources.description: Returns { is_known, label, category } for an EVM address — what it IS (not who owns it). category is one of sanctioned, mixer, exchange, bridge, dex_router, scam, drainer, phishing, token_contract, protocol, unknown. Sourced from OFAC, ScamSniffer, MEW, eth-labels and curated Base/Tornado sets. Never guesses.

Bidirectional name <-> address resolution for ENS (name.eth) and Basenames (name.base.eth) via public RPC + the resolver contracts directly. Reverse records are forward-verified against the input address (anti-spoofing). Auto-detects direction. Returns { query, kind, namespace, chain, resolved, address, name, sources, lookup }. XRPL .xrp names are detected but return resolved:false (no canonical registry).

query.q: required — an ENS/Basename name, an EVM 0x address, or an XRPL classic r-address
